summary.text: Mary Gill has represented the 35th District in the Illinois House of Representatives since March 2023.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature biography, she was born and raised in Beverly in Chicago and lives in Mount Greenwood with her husband and three children.
She is a former executive director of the Mount Greenwood Community and Business Association and a former special education teacher.
